name: timetimr
description: A customizable, Time Timer-inspired countdown timer. Runs as a website or a Windows/Mac/Linux desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run dist:win -w electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:web && npm run dist:mac -w electron
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:web && npm run dist:linux -w electron
scripts.dist:all: npm run build:web && npm run dist:all -w electron
